content:
olivia: Heads-up: HelixPay onboarding hit 429s during browser startup. Their SPA spawns multiple worker frames and each one runs sdk.init() immediately. Failures start ~10-20s after the onboarding demo. Logs: 

olivia: ```
2026-03-22T16:12:03Z worker-1 init /v1/preflight 200
2026-03-22T16:12:04Z worker-2 init /v1/preflight 429 x 12
2026-03-22T16:12:04Z worker-3 init /v1/preflight 429 x 9
2026-03-22T16:12:05Z main init /v1/preflight 200
2026-03-22T16:12:06Z worker-2 retry /v1/preflight 429
```

priya: Which SDK and auth pattern? Do they call preflight from each frame with the same key?

olivia: Browser SDK v1.8.0, currently using a dev-mode shared server key injected into each frame. No splay/guarding.

sam: Classic thundering herd. Quick customer-side mitigations we can give them now: 1) Only init on user interaction (click/focus) for non-visible frames. 2) Add randomized init wait (jitter) and a simple inflight guard per-origin. Example: ```js
// defer non-essential inits until user interacts
if (!document.hasFocus()) { window.addEventListener('focus', () => initWithJitter(), { once: true }); } else { initWithJitter(); }
function initWithJitter(){ const delay = 200 + Math.floor(Math.random()*1200); if (window.__RI_initPending) return; window.__RI_initPending = true; setTimeout(()=> sdk.init().finally(()=> window.__RI_initPending = false), delay); }
```

sam: Also strongly recommend issuing ephemeral session tokens per-tab. We can share a minimal endpoint that mints a short-lived token from their backend. Example curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.helixpay.example/internal/session-token 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <server-key>' 
  -d '{"user_id":"u123","expires_s":60}'
# returns {"token":"ey...","expires_at":"...""}
```

olivia: I'll send the above guidance. Can we do anything server-side for a fast fix?

sam: Yes — on our side we can: 1) enable tenant preflight_coalesce, 2) temporarily increase burst_window for tenant "helixpay" for 1 hour, 3) apply a leaky-bucket smoothing of 2s on preflight route for that tenant. Those should reduce immediate 429s while they roll ephemeral tokens.

ratebot: RateLimitMonitor: tenant="helixpay" 2026-03-22T16:11:58Z..2026-03-22T16:14:00Z peak=165 req/min preflight route. Suggest: preflight_coalesce=true, burst_window_inc=+200

priya: I'll coordinate with infra to flip the coalesce + burst flag. Sam, can you draft the infra-patch and TTL?

sam: Drafting now. Proposal: coalesce=true, burst_window=+200 tokens, ttl=60m, leaky_bucket=2000ms. I'll file change request and ping infra-oncall.

olivia: Customer is OK with a short maintenance window. I'll schedule a 15-min window and roll ephemeral-token support during that time. Will notify success contact and SE.

priya: Post-rollout checklist: 1) Monitor tenant 429 rate for 2 hours, 2) check per-route latency and error budget, 3) collect 10 init traces from different origins, 4) confirm ephemeral token issuance pattern. If 429s remain after client changes, escalate to runtime team for deeper kernel/batching investigation.

olivia: Perfect — sending notes to HelixPay and creating the support ticket with the snippets above. Thanks y'all :rocket:
